prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Celia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be aggressively fining anyone with a bin out after 8am starting next month. They are clearly obsessed with finding new ways to control us and hit us with heavy penalties."
text: The council is launching a ruthless, city-wide crackdown to hunt down every single bin left out, and they will be issuing massive, unavoidable fines to everyone starting next month. They are completely determined to punish us with these predatory penalties for the slightest infraction.
